import math
from gurobipy import *

def solve_problem():
    m = Model("Facility_Location")
    m.setParam("TimeLimit", 300)

    # Problem Data
    facilities = list(range(16))  # F0..F15
    customers = list(range(33))  # C0..C32

    # Facility coordinates (x, y)
    facility_coords = [(53, 7), (44, 42), (56, 64), (24, 80), (94, 13), (95, 85), (50, 94), (72, 7), (68, 97), (52, 17), (73, 18), (34, 53), (64, 97), (86, 42), (11, 6), (3, 39)]

    # Customer coordinates (x, y)
    customer_coords = [(66, 54), (71, 37), (24, 75), (78, 87), (0, 69), (55, 10), (97, 50), (68, 64), (95, 88), (28, 37), (43, 13), (52, 33), (99, 39), (16, 38), (39, 97), (59, 26), (4, 33), (72, 32), (73, 51), (56, 34), (67, 57), (90, 69), (63, 23), (32, 63), (89, 79), (47, 38), (89, 58), (80, 25), (72, 77), (34, 68), (91, 57), (61, 45), (58, 37)]

    facility_capacities = [108.0, 110.0, 150.0, 178.0, 112.0, 151.0, 93.0, 137.0, 171.0, 174.0, 164.0, 70.0, 148.0, 129.0, 123.0, 188.0]
    customer_demands = [29.0, 39.0, 16.0, 17.0, 26.0, 21.0, 19.0, 24.0, 46.0, 41.0, 20.0, 49.0, 40.0, 24.0, 21.0, 16.0, 41.0, 45.0, 11.0, 24.0, 34.0, 28.0, 15.0, 44.0, 45.0, 38.0, 49.0, 21.0, 18.0, 44.0, 30.0, 19.0, 48.0]
    fixed_costs = [317.0, 119.0, 477.0, 298.0, 498.0, 159.0, 369.0, 367.0, 102.0, 245.0, 174.0, 323.0, 371.0, 129.0, 425.0, 226.0]
    transport_rate = 0.5  # $/km/unit

    # COMPUTE distance matrix from coordinates (INDUCED COSTS)
    def euclidean_distance(coord1, coord2):
        return math.sqrt((coord1[0] - coord2[0])**2 + (coord1[1] - coord2[1])**2)

    distances = {}
    for i in facilities:
        for j in customers:
            distances[(i, j)] = euclidean_distance(facility_coords[i], customer_coords[j])

    # Decision Variables
    # Open_F{i}: Binary - whether facility i is opened
    open_facility = {}
    for i in facilities:
        open_facility[i] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"Open_F{i}")

    # Ship_F{i}_C{j}: Continuous - units shipped from facility i to customer j
    ship = {}
    for i in facilities:
        for j in customers:
            ship[(i, j)] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name=f"Ship_F{i}_C{j}")

    # Objective: Minimize fixed costs + transport costs
    # Transport cost = distance * rate * units shipped
    obj = quicksum(fixed_costs[i] * open_facility[i] for i in facilities)
    obj += quicksum(
        distances[(i, j)] * transport_rate * ship[(i, j)]
        for i in facilities for j in customers
    )
    m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

    # Demand satisfaction constraints
    for j in customers:
        m.addConstr(
            quicksum(ship[(i, j)] for i in facilities) >= customer_demands[j],
            name=f"Demand_C{j}"
        )

    # Capacity constraints (can only ship if facility is open)
    for i in facilities:
        m.addConstr(
            quicksum(ship[(i, j)] for j in customers) <= facility_capacities[i] * open_facility[i],
            name=f"Capacity_F{i}"
        )

    m.optimize()
    return m
